authority: CEO Round 161: 'Simulation budget follows novelty confidence. NOVELTY_CONFIDENCE < MEDIUM → NO_EXPENSIVE_SIMULATION. NOVELTY_CONFIDENCE ≥ MEDIUM → MECHANISM_SIMULATION. NOVELTY_SURVIVES_STRONGEST_ATTACK → INDEPENDENT_VIRTUAL_VALIDATION. INDEPENDENT + COMPETITOR_SUPERIORITY → WORLD_CLASS_REVIEW. This will save enormous amounts of compute. More importantly, it keeps the machine pointed at actual invention, rather than discovering increasingly sophisticated versions of things someone already patented.'
constitutional_basis: Article I — evidence precedes assertion (novelty evidence before simulation)
Article VII — never weaken the verifier to rescue a claim (cannot weaken novelty search to unlock simulation)
Article XIX — never optimize for the gate (cannot bypass novelty gate)
Article XXVIII — no silent semantic promotion (cannot promote 'no prior art found' to 'novelty survives')
Article XXXVI — Experiment Validity Gate (ratified Round 160)

the_rule.name: Simulation Budget Follows Novelty Confidence

the_chain.rationale: The candidate has not survived novelty search. Spending simulation budget on it is wasted effort — even if the simulation succeeds, the candidate cannot be promoted because it is prior-art threatened.
The candidate has survived Stage 0 novelty search. Mechanism simulation is now warranted to test whether the invention actually works.
The candidate has survived §102/§103 analysis. Independent reproduction via external solvers is now warranted.
The candidate has survived all technical gates. World-Class review (buyer fit, moat, strategic value) is now warranted.

the_rule.enforcement: This rule is mechanically enforced. The simulation script MUST check the candidate's novelty_confidence_level before executing. If novelty_confidence_level < 2, the script MUST refuse to run.

the_invention_generation_reframe.authority: CEO Round 161: 'Do not tell it: invent another smart shunt. Tell it: find an information bottleneck that the best existing smart shunt cannot resolve. Do not tell it: invent closed-loop CNS delivery. Tell it: find something that remains fundamentally unobservable even after the newly patented closed-loop CSF concentration system exists. Do not tell it: predict clot fragmentation. Tell it: find a physically causal pre-failure variable that existing thrombus models and devices cannot observe.'
the_invention_generation_reframe.the_shift: FROM: product-feature invention ('what can we build?') → TO: information-bottleneck invention ('what information is structurally unobservable with current technology, and how can we access it?')
the_invention_generation_reframe.why_this_is_stronger: Product features are easily patented around (the 2026 patents prove this). Information bottlenecks create STRUCTURAL moats — if the incumbent cannot observe the information, they cannot replicate the solution without a fundamentally different sensor/modality.

the_three_reframes.C1_space: DON'T: 'Invent another smart shunt.' DO: 'Find an information bottleneck that the best existing smart shunt cannot resolve.'
the_three_reframes.C3_space: DON'T: 'Invent closed-loop CNS delivery.' DO: 'Find something that remains fundamentally unobservable even after the newly patented closed-loop CSF concentration system exists.'
the_three_reframes.C5_space: DON'T: 'Predict clot fragmentation.' DO: 'Find a physically causal pre-failure variable that existing thrombus models and devices cannot observe, then determine whether that variable can become an actionable prediction.'

the_key_lesson_from_round_160.lesson: The fastest path to a World-Class invention is often killing the wrong invention early.
the_key_lesson_from_round_160.application: Round 160 killed three wrong inventions (C2-Y, C3-X, C5-X as currently defined) by discovering 2026 patent disclosures. This saved enormous simulation budget that would have been wasted.
the_key_lesson_from_round_160.the_rule_going_forward: Search before simulation. Always. No exceptions.
